title: Dogfight

description.en: An arcade dogfight in the browser. Take an F-22 into a sky full of Su-35s.
description.zh: 驾驶 F-22 迎战苏-35，在浏览器里体验街机风格的三维空战。

subject: Titanium F-22 desk model caught in a banking turn

source.description: Arcade 3D F-22 vs Su-35s dogfight in the browser ([Play](https://dogfight.hexly.ai))

subject.en: Titanium F-22 desk model caught in a banking turn
subject.zh: 掠过镜头的钛灰 F-22 模型

description.en: A broad-winged F-22 collectible banks diagonally toward the viewer. A gentle elevated product camera preserves the nose, both tail fins and the complete wing silhouette.
description.zh: 宽翼 F-22 模型斜向观者转弯。略俯视的产品镜头完整保留机鼻、双尾翼和两侧机翼。

description.en: Satin titanium and blue-gray panel faces define a real die-cast object. The amber canopy is the single warm material accent; there are no detached trails or effects.
description.zh: 缎面钛灰与蓝灰机身面板表现压铸模型，琥珀座舱是唯一暖色点缀，不添加脱离主体的尾迹。

description.en: Three swept flight lanes and short altitude ticks crossing a pale blue atmospheric field. The field, grain and contact shadow are independent of transparent app marks.
description.zh: 浅蓝纸面上的弯转航线与高度短刻度，呼应空战游戏。 底色、颗粒与接触阴影均独立于透明应用标记。

palette.source: Adopted Dogfight presentation, 2026-09-07-01/02; background.base in archived settings.json

sizeNote.en: At 128/64 px, the broad wings and amber canopy remain clear. At 32/24/16 px, the compact silhouette and dominant colors carry recognition; fine material detail, printed marks and background lines naturally merge.
sizeNote.zh: 128/64 px 能辨认宽翼与琥珀座舱；32/24/16 px 以紧凑轮廓和主色维持识别，精细材质、印记与背景线条自然合并。

goal.en: Fly an F-22 through a complete browser arcade mission using target locks, missiles, a cannon, and countermeasures.
goal.zh: 在浏览器中驾驶 F-22，运用锁定、导弹、机炮和干扰完成一场街机空战。

role.zh: 程序化机体与三维环境

role.en: Synthesized engine, weapon, and alert sounds
role.zh: 合成引擎、武器与警报音效

description.en: Three swept flight lanes cross short altitude ticks, following the aircraft’s banking turn.
description.zh: 三条掠过的航线穿过短刻度，顺着战机侧倾转弯的方向延伸。

alt.en: Titanium F-22 desk model caught in a banking turn on a Hexly campaign canvas
alt.zh: 掠过镜头的钛灰 F-22 模型，置于 Hexly 宣发画布

description.en: Titanium F-22 desk model caught in a banking turn.
description.zh: 掠过镜头的钛灰 F-22 模型。

description.en: Preserve the exact project identity and the separately recorded Hexly artwork. Hexly paper, ink and terracotta belong to archive and campaign surfaces only; independent product palettes and themes stay their own.
description.zh: 项目原标与单独记录的 Hexly 主视觉均保持形状和原色。Hexly 纸色、墨色和陶土色只用于档案及宣发画布，各产品色板与主题独立保留。

description.en: Preserve the complete subject and its original square margins. Resize uniformly; never trim the canvas to force detail. Keep external clear space of at least 1/8 of the mark canvas height around standalone marks and lockups. Wide and mobile Heroes are separate compositions of existing artwork, with no image-model call.
description.zh: 保留完整主体与原有方形留白，只做等比缩放，不裁图强凑细节。独立标志及字标组合四周，至少留出标志画布高度 1/8 的外部净空。宽幅与手机 Hero 分别排版，没有新图像模型调用。

description.en: Navigation 24px preferred, 16px minimum. Wordmark ≥88px wide; lockup ≥160px. Use transparent PNG/ICO at small sizes without a tile, extra red dot, shadow or rounded mask. Fine facets soften at 16px.
description.zh: 导航推荐 24px，最小 16px。字标宽度至少 88px，组合至少 160px。小尺寸使用透明 PNG/ICO，不加底板、红点、阴影或圆角遮罩；16px 时细小切面会柔化。
